SELECT 'R3S2' as remType, fp.FINPROD_ID as assetId, fp.Finprod_Market_Id as assetCode, fp.FINPROD_NAME as assetName, (case when tpd.PS = 'T24' then '回款确认' when tpd.PS = 'T02' then '卖出' when tpd.PS = 'T11' then '现金分红' end ) as reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL as url, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS as days FROM (SELECT distinct '01' VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.WORKFLOW_ID, T1.B_TRADE_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM (SELECT * FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL UNION ALL SELECT W1.* FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL W1 INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL W2 ON W1.B_TRADE_ID = W2.TRADE_ID WHERE W1.PS IN ('T24')) T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE (T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag}) and T1.TRADE_STATUS = '01') tpd LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tpd.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on 1 = 1 WHERE tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{fund} AND tpd.PS in ('T24', #{ps_T02}, #{ps_T11}) and fpt.type_6 = #{monetaryFund} AND T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S2} AND tpd.TRADE_DATE - CAST(T5.DAYS) <= #{quaryDate} AND tpd.TRADE_DATE >= #{quaryDate} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S2} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID)

SELECT #{R3S5} remType, finprodMarketId assetCode, FINPROD_ID assetId, assetName assetName, CONCAT(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mDate,'%Y-%m-%d'),'') , '付息还本到期' )as reminder, mDate, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID as menuId, REMINDER_SET.URL as url, REMINDER_SET.LABLE as lable, REMINDER_SET.DEALF as dealF, REMINDER_SET.CLOSF as closF, REMINDER_SET.days FROM (
) a LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R3S5} where 1=1 group by finprodMarketId, FINPROD_ID, finprodMarketName,
assetName,
mDate, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID, REMINDER_SET.URL, REMINDER_SET.LABLE, REMINDER_SET.DEALF, REMINDER_SET.CLOSF, REMINDER_SET.days order by mDate desc

select 'R3S4' as remType, T1.Finprod_Id as assetId, T1.Finprod_Market_Id as assetCode, T1.FINPROD_NAME as assetName, '货币基金分红' as reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL as url, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1, FIN_CASH_INFO T2, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE T3, SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{fund} AND T1.PROFIT_TYPE = #{currency} AND T3.PAY_CYCLE = #{paycycle} AND CONCAT(SUBSTRING(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(#{quaryDate},'%Y-%m-%d'),''), 0, 8) , (case WHEN t3.day_value < 10 THEN CONCAT_WS( '','0',t3.day_value ) ELSE t3.day_value END ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{quaryDate},'%Y-%m-%d')) AND T3.EFF_DATE <= #{quaryDate} AND T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S4}
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S4} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T4 where T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T4.PS IN (#{ps_T11},#{ps_T12}) AND T4.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag})

SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID assetId, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID assetCode, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME assetName, 'R3S14' as remType, CONCAT((case when T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' then '质押式正回购' else '质押式逆回购' end ) , DATE_FORMAT(T1.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') , '到期') reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T1.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T1.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S14} WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND ( T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) and T3.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S14} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID )

SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID assetId, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID assetCode, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME assetName, 'R3S15' as remType, CONCAT(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(T1.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') ,''), '到期') reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T1.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T1.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = 'R3S15' WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND ( T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) and T3.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S15} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC

select T10.FINPROD_ID assetId, T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetCode, T10.FINPROD_ABBR assetName, 'R3S13' as remType, CONCAT(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(T8.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d'),'') , '付息还本到期') reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T8.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS from (select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE,
t7.PAY_DATE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T1.CDATE, (T6.CASH_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) fpriceAmt, case t6.CASH_TYPE when '01' then 0 else (T6.PRIN_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, (t6.INT_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) intAmt, t6.PAY_DATE from PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id=t6.finprod_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID
and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID
and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07'
and T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP ON PSP.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCP.MDATE < T6.MDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID
and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID
and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and t6.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID and PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND PSP.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND FCP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' and PSP.AMOUNT > 0) where T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName})) T7 group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE ) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13} where 1 = 1 AND ( T8.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T8.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} )
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID ) GROUP BY T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID , T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.FINPROD_ABBR , t8.MDATE, T5.MENU_ID, URL, LABLE, DEALF, CLOSF, DAYS ORDER BY T8.MDATE
